main.description: Your Rainshare profile: your AI plans, what you run, how much you have to spare, and who you'd like to help first. The public copy lives in your repo. A fuller copy (with fields you keep private) can live in your repo inside each group's Rainshare space, where only its members can read it.

displayName.description: Your name on Rainshare, if it should be different from the one on your Bluesky profile. Left out, apps use your Bluesky profile's.

bio.description: A line or two about you and what you're building, if it should be different from your Bluesky profile's description. Left out, apps use that.

plans.description: The coding subscriptions you have, by provider rather than tier. zai: Z.ai's GLM Coding Plan. free: free tiers only. Older records may say claude-pro, claude-max, chatgpt-plus or chatgpt-pro, which apps read as claude or chatgpt. none: no AI plan. Takes over from budget and a setup's plan, which apps read when this is missing.

budget.description: Roughly what you spend on AI each month. none: no paid AI. free: free tiers only. low: under $25. medium: $25 to $99. high: $100 or more. sponsored: an employer, school or grant pays.

circumstances.description: Self-described, and only what you choose to share. Helpers can choose to put people in these situations first.

values.description: What you care about (for example accessibility, climate, privacy, local-first).

priorities.description: Whose seeds you'd like to see first when you have rain to spare.

offering.description: Kinds of work you're happy to take on (languages, frameworks, areas).
